news.title: UW-Madison information related to Sept. 23 Langdon St. incident
news.summary_en: The university is fully committed to preventing and addressing hazing. A recent incident occurred at an unrecognized student organization.

news.title: Enlisting AI in the fight against drug-resistant bacteria
news.summary_en: UW–Madison researchers identify new ways to address bacterial infections, which could accelerate alternatives to traditional antibiotics.

news.title: Great expectations for UW hockey
news.summary_en: As the college hockey seasons ramp up, the men’s and women’s teams aim to capitalize on their spectacular 2025-26 seasons.

news.title: A new home for the UW Athletic Hall of Fame
news.summary_en: Opening last week, the Ray Kubly Plaza outside the Kohl Center recognizes hundreds of Badger greats.

news.title: The return of UW’s rarest books
news.summary_en: After an 18-month hiatus, Memorial Library’s Special Collections — and its 300,000 invaluable objects — are accessible again.

news.title: Tiny quantum nanostructures could make AI less of an energy hog
news.summary_en: An emerging technology designed by UW–Madison engineers has the potential to make AI systems faster and significantly more energy efficient.

news.title: Meet the students making space for Women in Entrepreneurship
news.summary_en: The student organization is enabling hundreds of women at UW–Madison to step confidently into entrepreneurial spaces.

news.title: Ireland, meet UW–Madison
news.summary_en: An Irish delegation promoting the Aer Lingus College Football Classic visited campus last week, creating connections and collaborative opportunities in advance of next year’s international game.

news.title: UW rises to 8th among publics, 34th overall, in U.S. News rankings
news.summary_en: “Best Value Schools” ranking also jumps 23 spots, placing UW–Madison 24th in the nation.
